verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is a one-line claim that Synctera can 'create and manage scheduled payments for customers.' That is a domain-specific form of recurring automation, not general job or workflow scheduling. Webhooks are event-push only and do not provide scheduling. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of recurring jobs/workflows, documented recurrence options (cron/intervals), detail on the scheduled payments API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
